speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent; to help you, I must first ask: Are your seizures occurring at a regular interval, and do they involve rhythmic jerking of your limbs or eyes? Have you experienced any difficulty feeding, poor responsiveness, or temperature instability since birth? Did your mother have any infections, high fever, or unexplained bleeding during labor or immediately after delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intraventricular Hemorrhage (IVH) due to Germinal Matrix Hemorrhage.

The clinical picture of a 31-week preterm infant with a history of chorioamnionitis, low Apgar scores, and sudden onset of lethargy and tonic seizures is highly suggestive of an IVH. I need to confirm this with imaging immediately.

REQUEST IMAGES: Head_Ultrasound; REQUEST TEST: Serum_Electrolytes_and_Glucose.
